comments.author: Vultify
comments.body_html: Should be fixed now. The zip was using Windows-style backslash paths internally instead of proper forward slashes, which some Linux unzip tools choke on and can end up creating that folder with broken permissions. Repackaged it correctly and replaced the file — same download link, just re-download and it should extract clean now. Let me know if it’s still acting up!
